name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 41 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-04-20, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.88 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
